description: Turn a list of business questions into a dashboard specification with a tile and visualisation per question. At dashboard design time, before building it in a BI tool. Do not choose this when you need the dashboard built or the data queried. Example requests: Turn these questions into a dashboard spec. | Design a dashboard for these business questions. | What tiles should this dashboard have?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

available_tables.description: The customer's tables.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Available tables, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

questions.description: The customer's questions.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Business questions, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_dashboard_spec_from_questions
title: Dashboard spec from questions
